chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAlī ibn Bajīl that he said:
I saw Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام, whenever he prostrated and then raised his head, he would take the pebbles from his forehead and place them on the ground.
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith show about Imam al-Ṣādiq’s practice during sajdah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام during sajdah, specifically that pebbles would adhere to his forehead and he would return them to the ground after raising his head. It is relevant in discussions of the materials and manner of prostration in salat (prayer), especially in the jurisprudence of sajdah.
